content.title: Demi Lovato Says She Loves Husband Jutes 'More and More' Every Day Ahead of Their 1st Wedding Anniversary (Exclusive)
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Demi Lovato spoke exclusively to PEOPLE about married life with Jordan "Jutes" LutesShe says she loves her musician husband "more and more" every day ahead of their first wedding anniversaryThe couple tied the knot in Santa Barbara, Calif., in May 2025 Demi Lovato's love for Jordan "Jutes" Lutes continues to grow. The "Here All Night" singer, 33, opened up about married life in an exclusive interview with PEOPLE and shared that she loves her musician husband, 34, "more and more" every day. "I genuinely thought on my wedding day, 'I can't love this man anymore than I already do.' And then a few weeks, months go by, and I'm like, 'Oh, my God, I thought that I was maxed out on love and now I'm maxed out on love,' " she says. "And it's just like every day, I just love him more and more. And I didn't know that was possible," adds Lovato, who has partnered with beverage brand Caliwater, co-founded by Vanessa Hudgens and Oliver Trevena, to launch its new Blood Orange flavor. Jutes and Demi Lovato in Los Angeles in January 2026. Gilbert Flores/Billboard via Getty Lovato shared more thoughts about her married era during a conversation with Mario Lopez for Access Hollywood — which aired on Feb. 20 — revealing the "best part" of marriage with her husband. "Oh, I love it. It's so much fun," she said of being wed to Jutes. "I just have the best time with him. We will stay up so late just laughing until we're crying, and I think that's the best part about being married to your best friend. It's just like a giant sleepover every night." Lovato went on to rave about her husband, telling Lopez, "He's so incredible. He's so amazing. I love him so much. He's so talented, so supportive, so caring — I could go on and on about him." She also noted how Jutes has inspired "so much" of her work, before recalling how they first connected over their passion for music. "We met in the studio, which was a beautiful beginning to our love story. He came in as a songwriter on my last album, Holy Fvck, and we just connected. We became friends and then later on started dating — and the rest is history." Jutes and Demi Lovato in Los Angeles on Feb. 2, 2026. BACKGRID Lovato and Jutes are months away from celebrating their first wedding anniversary. They tied the knot on May 25, 2025, in Santa Barbara, Calif. Opening up about the big day to Vogue, Lovato said she "just felt loved" in the moment as she wed Jutes surrounded by their family and friends. Jutes and Demi Lovato at their wedding on May 25, 2025. BACKGRID "All that life has brought me to this moment, and it was more than worth it. It was so special being able to marry my best friend, my soulmate, and the love of my life," she told the outlet. "It’s hard to put into words what Jordan means to me. To find a love like this has completed my life in so many ways." "We both put the work into ourselves first to be ready and open to share a life together, and I think that is a really important part of our relationship," she continued. "We don’t complete each other as we did the work to complete ourselves first — and I think that’s a really important thing to do.” Related Stories For his part, Jutes told Vogue, “I’m so excited to start this life with my soulmate. It feels like we’ve been married forever, and now we officially are." He said he was "excited to do life" with Lovato, whom he called his "best friend." "To be able to wake up with Demi, to be surrounded by her infectious laugh, her playful spirit, and her loving heart is a true gift and one that I don’t take for granted," he told the outlet. 0 seconds of 0 secondsVolume 0%Loading ad00:2500:0000:46 3 Things to Know About Alex Cooper
